explication: Petrichor is an offline macOS music player. Its main workflow is to add music folders, extract track metadata into a persistent library, browse or organize that library, then queue and play tracks. Separate product areas cover playlists, internet radio, lyrics, artist information, and macOS automation and playback controls. The graph reflects the documented capabilities and sampled manager/backend responsibilities; some subsystem links are omitted because their call sites were not included in the excerpts.
